Friendzy / Classic party games / The Word Factory

How to play The Word Factory

One big word. Race to make tiny ones. Call out a long word. Everyone has 60 seconds to write (or mentally note) as many smaller words as they can make from its letters. Most valid words wins.

2–10 players~10 minBrainy & CompetitiveWord games🚗 Works in the car

How to play

  1. Someone picks a long word (at least 8 letters). Example: 'Celebration'.
  2. Everyone has 60 seconds to find smaller words using only the letters in that word.
  3. You can only use each letter as many times as it appears.
  4. After time's up, compare lists — duplicates cancel out, unique words score.
  5. Most unique valid words wins the round.

Example round

  • 'Celebration' → 'table', 'rice', 'tone', 'baron', 'coin', 'tire', 'lion'...
  • 'Friendship' → 'friend', 'rind', 'ship', 'fiend', 'drip', 'pine'...
  • Someone finds 'discombobulate' in a 10-letter word. Instant legend.

Tips

  • Start with 3-letter words, then build up — you'll find more.
  • Good source words: 'submarine', 'generation', 'celebration', 'restaurant'.
